#6 DISTRIBUTED EXECUTION CONTROL (audited head c6c1c3d): cross-worker cancellation was authoritative only at _finish_turn's final-commit boundary (corrective #3) -- a DIFFERENT worker's in-flight turn did not observe a cross-worker cancel/stop/expiry until it reached that point, so it could still call the model again AND dispatch NEW tool calls to the NXS-P08 Tool Engine after cancellation had already committed elsewhere. FIX: AgentRuntime.run_turn now takes a check_authority callback (AgentService._check_execution_authority -- a cheap, unlocked, tenant-scoped read of the session's current committed state), called at the top of every continuation iteration (before the next model call) and immediately before every NEW tool dispatch (never before a deduplicated call). The moment the session is observed terminal, an internal ExecutionRevoked signal aborts the loop and routes through the SAME _fail_turn / _raise_for_stale_session machinery correctives #3/#4/#5 already use (cannot resurrect the session). PostgreSQL stays sole authority; no NATS/pub-sub correctness dependency introduced; process-local _turn_tasks/_locks remain a same-process latency optimisation only. Documented, tested boundary: operations DISPATCHED before the authoritative cancellation commits may complete; no operation is DISPATCHED after it has committed and been observed by the next checkpoint. Orphaned RUNNING turn (worker crash): migration e1f2a3b4c5d6 adds durable execution_owner_id / lease_expires_at primitives to ai_agent_turns (set once at claim, never renewed, never backfilled) -- an UNAMBIGUOUS orphan signal, but P13 performs NO autonomous reaping itself, deferred to NXS-P25 per new requirement NXS-AGENT-002 (PLANNED, target NXS-P25). Adversarial validation: independent red-team subagent (GO; 1 MEDIUM -- a boundary test that couldn't distinguish checkpoint-present from checkpoint-absent -- fixed by adding a genuine second tool dispatch, re-verified fail-first) and independent final-auditor subagent (AUDIT: GO; 1 MEDIUM -- a premature lifecycle-gate claim, corrected; 3 LOW -- one closed by a new claim-discipline regression test, two accepted as documented residual notes on the lease margin and on unverifiable execution-based gate claims).
